ValidationRule.description: [IRM feedback row OppVR41] Requires Unit of Measure on moving into Solutioning, Negotiation or Booking Verification, for cross-sell/upsell deals. Simplified per IRM feedback.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.ECommerce_Deal_Bypass),
OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Framework_Parent_Opportunity' ),
ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Cross-Sell/Upsell'),
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Qualification'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booking Verification') ),
ISPICKVAL(IM_Unit_of_Measure__c, '') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Unit of Measure is required to advance to the next stage. Please select a value.
